name: com.questvisionstream.unity
description: Reusable Unity client library for QuestVisionStream V2: streams the Quest passthrough camera to the QuestVisionStreamServer over WebRTC and surfaces the returned detections (world-space bounding-box rendering lives in the companion com.ethar.debugdrawingbbox package). Built as RealityCollective Service Framework services with swappable service modules (WebRTC transport, camera capture, image qualifiers, tag detectors).
